gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-wix-madefor-text: Wix Madefor Text keeps its terminals open and easy. Down a full page it reads smoothly, while Shantell Sans, with its single nib width and wide mouths, carries the personality up top.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-zcool-xiaowei: Rope-like strokes meet a gentler, tapered line. Shantell Sans keeps every stem and bowl at one nib width up top, while ZCOOL XiaoWei below tapers softly like a sharpened pencil line.
gen-gf-sniglet-fs-alpino: Alpino reads tall, cozy and casual. Across a full block of text its curve endings stay well apart, easing its stingy spacing, while Sniglet keeps a lower lowercase above.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-ar-one-sans: Commanding Sniglet moves in lockstep, curves and stems alike. AR One Sans, lifting its brush ends before each curve closes, reads with a modern lightness all the way down the page.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-bpmf-huninn: A level, quiet beat from Sniglet, then outlines below. Bpmf Huninn, with its single-weight outline feel and wide channel into every bowl, can be set a touch larger to let those openings show.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-cairo-play: Open round letters stay clear at small sizes, quietly doing their job. Cairo Play sits beside Sniglet, whose line has no modulation, as the modern partner to a commanding heading.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-noto-sans-old-south-ar: Approachable curved strokes that end before turning inward carry the text in Noto Sans Old South Arabian, under a Sniglet heading. Sniglet draws plain, constant-width lines, giving the two a quiet agreement.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-rethink-sans: Level, commanding Sniglet up top, then approachable, modern Rethink Sans with openings that stay generous at every weight. That shared stroke weight is what keeps the two so agreeable.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-roboto-flex: Roboto Flex leaves a wide slot between the c's two ends. Sniglet, drawn like thin wire, makes a heading stand out, while Roboto Flex simply stays readable and approachable beneath.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-suse-mono: A rope-thin outline with no swelling or thinning defines Sniglet, above SUSE Mono with its open curves and clear gaps. Extra space around each letter keeps everything easy to follow.
